source: https://betterdiscord.app/plugins — raw URLs taken from each plugin's page and pinned to a commit; sha256 verified by the harness before staging
note: BD starter set (5-10 popular real plugins, per AGENTS.md). Owner approval pending in QUESTIONS.md Q1; this is the recommended default and was used to keep moving. Every entry downloads at run time — nothing is vendored into the repository.

entries.name: BlurNSFW
entries.tier3: Open a NSFW-marked channel: its media must be blurred until hovered; other channels unaffected.

entries.name: APlatformIndicators
entries.tier3: Member list and chat authors show platform dots/badges (desktop, web, mobile); settings panel opens.

entries.name: GameActivityToggle
entries.tier3: The games panel shows a toggle that hides/shows the current activity; setting persists across restart.

entries.name: BetterFolders
entries.tier3: Server folders behave normally; the plugin's settings panel opens and folder options apply.

entries.name: InvisibleTyping
entries.tier3: While typing, the other side must NOT see the typing indicator; toggling the plugin restores it.

entries.name: PinDMs
entries.tier3: Right-click a DM → pin: it moves to a pinned section at the top of the DM list and survives restart.

entries.name: Translator
entries.tier3: Foreign-language messages show a translate affordance; translating swaps the text and sends translated text outbound.

entries.name: DoNotTrack
entries.tier3: The plugin's settings show the tracking endpoints it blocks; no page-load errors while browsing.

entries.name: LiveTyping
entries.tier3: While the other side types, their in-progress text appears live under the channel header.

entries.name: ChannelTabs
entries.tier3: A tab bar appears above the chat; opening channels adds tabs, clicking a tab switches channels.
